observations: Footing reinforcement mismatch: calc 'No.4 bars at 6.0 in c/c bottom' (As 0.4 in2/ft) vs drawing TF 12"X18" '(3) #4 TOP, (3) #4 BOTTOM LONG. & #4 @18" O.C TRANS.' Footing size 12" (Ly = 1 ft) x 18" (h = 18 in) matches.
Concrete strength mismatch: calc f'c = 4000 psi vs drawing lap splice schedule F'c= 2500 PSI AT 28 DAYS.
Footing cover cnom = 2 in in calc (cast against earth typically requires 3 in).
Soil bearing: calc qallow_Gross = 3.5 ksf with no geotechnical value stated on drawings; qmax/qallow = 0.884.

Footing loads FDz1 = 1.2 kips, FLz1 = 1.0 kips, FEz1 = 1.4 kips per ft (vertical seismic wall load governs, comb 14) are not consistent with shear-wall top loads (D 135 lb/ft, Lr 180 lb/ft) - appear placeholder.

Shear wall lateral loads W = 135 lbs and Eq = 40 lbs are identical for W1, W2, W3 and IW, and Lf = 140 lb/ft floor live load is applied to a one-story garage with no floor above - placeholder loads; no wind/seismic base shear derivation is included.
SDS = 1 and Ie = 1.25 used in shear wall calcs; Ie = 1.25 corresponds to Risk Category III, not a residential garage (RC II, Ie = 1.0).
W2: 20 ft wall with 16 ft x 7 ft garage door at Po1 = 2 ft leaves only ~2 ft piers, yet calc uses segments b1 = 7.75 ft and b2 = 9.25 ft; all W2 results identical to W3 (copied).
W1 sheet 1 (panel geometry, construction, hole/Aen) is missing from the package text; W1 segment lengths 3.083 ft + 17.917 ft = 21 ft vs S-4 elevation lengths (20'-0"/24'-0" labels ambiguous).
W1 ft = -8 lb/in2 for T = -0.056 kips, while W2/W3 print ft = -7 lb/in2 for the same T with Aen = 7.5 in2 - inconsistent.
Combined OSB + gypsum seismic capacity vsc = 800 lb/ft (2 x min) used for W1-W3; IW is gypsum-only both faces (vsc 800 lb/ft) yet uses Cd = 4 (wood structural panel value).

Drawings show no hold-down hardware or shear wall schedule/nailing schedule (only 'ANCHOR BOLT & HOLD DOWN PER PLAN'); calc sheathing 3/8" OSB w/ 6d @ 6" + 5/8" gypsum 0.120" nails @ 4"/7" is not specified on drawings. IW shows net uplift T = 0.020 kips.
Truss reactions (T1B Max Grav 1051 lb at 2-0-0 o.c.; TCDL 18.0 + BCDL 7.0 psf) exceed shear wall top loads D 135 lb/ft + Lr 180 lb/ft assumed in calcs.

Edition mismatch: drawings cite 2022 CRC (and UBC note); Tedds calcs use NDS2018/ASCE 7-16 (consistent with 2022) but footing uses ACI318-14 (2022 CBC adopts ACI 318-19); MiTek trusses use IBC2024/TPI2022 and ASCE 7-22.
Truss uplifts (96-119 lb) require mechanical connections by others; drawings show A35 @ 12" O.C. and H4/SP4 clips but no truss-to-plate uplift connector callout.
Anchor bolt callouts inconsistent across details: 5/8"x8" @ 24" O.C. vs 5/8" DIA.X6" EMBED @ 16" O.C. / @ 32" O.C.; J-bolt 'SEE SCHEDULE' but no anchor bolt schedule present.
